description: This file declares the WindowManagerHandler class and its nested Notification class, which manage window events and interactions with the IRDKWindowManager interface within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler
classes.description: Main class managing window events, initialization, termination, and interaction with the window manager interface.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the IRDKWindowManager::INotification interface to handle window-related notifications.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager handler with the service and event handler.

methods.name: renderReady
methods.description: Checks if the application instance is ready for rendering.

methods.name: enableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables display rendering for a given application instance.
